messages.subject: Plyr: basic question regarding ddply
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to do the following:

> library(plyr)
> ddply(iris, .(Species), mean)
Sepal.Length Sepal.Width Petal.Length Petal.Width Species
1 5.006 3.428 1.462 0.246 NA
2 5.936 2.770 4.260 1.326 NA
3 6.588 2.974 5.552 2.026 NA
Warning messages:
1: In mean.default(X[[5L]], ...) :
argument is not numeric or logical: returning NA
2: In mean.default(X[[5L]], ...) :
argument is not numeric or logical: returning NA
3: In mean.default(X[[5L]], ...) :
argument is not numeric or logical: returning NA

How should I modify this to get rid of these Warnigns?

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
